cues: Agile methods, like Scrum, follow the Agile Manifesto of two thousand and one.
The product owner keeps a prioritised backlog.
The team takes the top items into a sprint of one to four weeks, meets daily for fifteen minutes, and ends with a working, shippable increment, a review and a retrospective.
Requirements may change freely between sprints.
The cost: little documentation, and it needs an engaged customer.
